about: Environment props for tools/art/meshy_prop.py (Meshy text-to-3D, Smart Topology). role picks where the game uses it: obstacle (a blocked-cell filler of the procedural kind named in kind, drawn by the thousand, so a tight lod0 and a lod1 at 40% of it that phones switch to early), resource (a gatherable node for ResourceKind kind, two LODs), landmark (a map landmark kind) or siege (a siege unit id; owner-colour cloth). height and footprint are metres for scenery and authored units (before AlphaWorldArt.UnitScale) for siege; the finish bakes them into the vertices so every instance scale the game applies stays meaningful. polycount is what Meshy is asked for; lod0/lod1 are the triangle budgets the finish decimates to. farShell: the far level is a closed skin around the model (voxel remesh, then decimation) instead of a decimation of it, for crowns and bushes made of a hundred loose shards that decimation turns to shreds. Plan: 2026-09-24 environment workflow.
